arms.update: three sequential real KLPO policy updates; fresh on-policy bank per step
SFT adapter state then three fresh KLPO updates from that policy

online_rl.bank_rule: one use only; no replay; new policy version and fresh independent auxiliary draws each step
online_rl.failure_rule: incomplete/invalid/unverified trajectory reward is zero and remains recorded
online_rl.probability_contract: actual sampled token ids and collection-policy q log-probabilities

parent_rule: all trainable arms begin from the same frozen parent and rank-2 last-q adapter geometry

release.claim_limit: mechanism transfer into Gemma; not ADAM or Kaine sovereign-model training

selection.allowed: development tasks plus frozen pre-existing canaries
selection.breed_rule: freeze every candidate before opening independent eval; never merge/select on eval
selection.forbidden: independent_eval tasks, eval transcript sessions, or eval family markers
